statement.p: Find the perimeter and area of the trapezoid above. Side lengths are measurements.
The bottom has length \displaystyle{7.40}; top has length \displaystyle{11.61}. The sides have lengths \displaystyle{9.19} and \displaystyle{10.85}. The height is \displaystyle{9.01}.

solution.p: The perimeter is the sum of the four sides which are given. \displaystyle{11.61}+{10.85}+{7.40}+{9.19}={39.05}.
